title: Lower bound for a prescribed walk
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $u,v$ be vertices. If a sequence $w$ of neighbor indices, each in $ in{D}$, takes the walk from $u$ to $v$, then the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $w$’s length takes the walk from $u$ to $v$ is at least $D^{-	ext{length}(w)}$.
hypotheses_covered: w is a finite sequence of neighbor indices
w takes the walk from u to v
